# Game Idea: Orbit Escape

- Control a small ship on an HTML canvas, thrusting and rotating to dodge a constantly scrolling field of asteroids.
- Collect occasional fuel cells to extend your flight time and shield pickups to survive one hit.
- **Lose condition:** The ship collides with any asteroid or runs out of fuel.
- Simple physics and score based on distance traveled; easy to implement with canvas drawing and keyboard controls.

<content>
1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Ship state
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: W / 2,
13:     y: H * 0.8,
14:     angle: 0,
15:     radius: 10,
16:     thrust: 0,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:     fuel: 100,
20:     shield: false,
21:   };
22: 
23: const keys = {};
24: addEventListener('keydown', e => {
25:   keys[e.code] = true;
26:   // Unlock audio on first interaction
27:   if (!audioUnlocked) {
28:     unlockAudio();
29:     audioUnlocked = true;
30:   }
31: });
32: addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
33: // Sound management
34: let audioUnlocked = false;
35: function unlockAudio() {
36:   // Play a silent sound to satisfy user gesture requirement
37:   const unlock = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
38:   unlock.play();
39: }
40: const thrustAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freecodecamp/cdn@main/sound/beep.wav');
41: thrustAudio.loop = true;
42: const pickupAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freecodecamp/cdn@main/sound/powerup.wav');
43: const explosionAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freecodecamp/cdn@main/sound/explosion.wav');
44: const gameOverAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freecodecamp/cdn@main/sound/gameover.wav');
45: 
46:   // Asteroids, pickups, and stars
47:   const stars = [];
48:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
49:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
50:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 2 + 1 });
51:   }
52:   const shipTrail = [];
53:   const MAX_TRAIL = 12;
54:   // Asteroids & pickups
55:   const asteroids = [];
56:   const pickups = [];
57: 
58:   function spawnAsteroid() {
59:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 15;
60:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -size, r: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 });
61:   }
62:   function spawnPickup() {
63:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'fuel' : 'shield';
64:     pickups.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -20, r: 8, type, speed: 1.5 });
65:   }
66:   let spawnTimer = 0;
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     // Update ship trail
70:     shipTrail.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, angle: ship.angle });
71:     if (shipTrail.length > MAX_TRAIL) shipTrail.shift();
72:     // Controls
73:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 0.06 * dt;
74:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 0.06 * dt;
75:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
76:       ship.thrust = 0.1;
77:       ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
78:       if (thrustAudio.paused) thrustAudio.play();
79:     } else {
80:       ship.thrust = 0;
81:       thrustAudio.pause();
82:       thrustAudio.currentTime = 0;
83:     }
84:     // Apply thrust
85:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust * dt;
86:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust * dt;
87:     // Simple drag
88:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
89:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
90:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
91:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
92:     // Keep on screen
93:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = W;
94:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x = 0;
95:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = H;
96:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y = H;
97: 
98:     // Spawn objects
99:     spawnTimer += dt;
100:     if (spawnTimer > 1500) {
101:       spawnAsteroid();
102:       if (Math.random() < 0.3) spawnPickup();
103:       spawnTimer = 0;
104:     }
105: 
106:     // Update asteroids
107:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
108:       const a = asteroids[i];
109:       a.y += a.speed * dt;
110:       if (a.y - a.r > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
111:       // Collision
112:       const dx = a.x - ship.x, dy = a.y - ship.y;
113:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + ship.radius) {
114:         if (ship.shield) { ship.shield = false; asteroids.splice(i, 1); }
115:         else { gameOver(); return; }
116:       }
117:     }
118:     // Update pickups
119:     for (let i = pickups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
120:       const p = pickups[i];
121:       p.y += p.speed * dt;
122:       if (p.y - p.r > H) pickups.splice(i, 1);
123:       const dx = p.x - ship.x, dy = p.y - ship.y;
124:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < p.r + ship.radius) {
125:         if (p.type === 'fuel') ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
126:         else ship.shield = true;
127:         pickups.splice(i, 1);
128:       }
129:     }
130:   }
131: 
132:   let last = performance.now();
133:   let running = true;
134:   function loop() {
135:     if (!running) return;
136:     const now = performance.now();
137:     const dt = now - last;
138:     last = now;
139:     update(dt);
140:     draw();
141:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   }
143: 
144:   function draw() {
145:     // Background gradient
146:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, H);
147:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001020');
148:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000010');
149:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
150:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
151:     // Stars (twinkling)
152:     stars.forEach(s => {
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5) + ')';
154:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r);
155:     });
156:     // Ship trail
157:     for (let i = 0; i < shipTrail.length; i++) {
158:       const t = shipTrail[i];
159:       const alpha = i / shipTrail.length * 0.5;
160:       ctx.save();
161:       ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
162:       ctx.translate(t.x, t.y);
163:       ctx.rotate(t.angle);
164:       ctx.beginPath();
165:       ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
166:       ctx.lineTo(-8, -5);
167:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 5);
168:       ctx.closePath();
169:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
170:       ctx.fill();
171:       ctx.restore();
172:     }
173:     // Ship
174:     ctx.save();
175:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
176:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
177:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 12);
178:     grad.addColorStop(0, ship.shield ? 'cyan' : 'lightgray');
179:     grad.addColorStop(1, ship.shield ? '#0044ff' : 'gray');
180:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
181:     ctx.beginPath();
182:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
183:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
184:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
185:     ctx.closePath();
186:     ctx.fill();
187:     ctx.restore();
188:     // Asteroids
189:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
190:       const gradA = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
191:       gradA.addColorStop(0, '#777');
192:       gradA.addColorStop(1, '#333');
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
195:       ctx.fillStyle = gradA;
196:       ctx.fill();
197:     });
198:     // Pickups
199:     pickups.forEach(p => {
200:       ctx.save();
201:       ctx.shadowColor = p.type === 'fuel' ? 'lime' : 'orange';
202:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
203:       ctx.beginPath();
204:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
205:       ctx.fillStyle = p.type === 'fuel' ? 'lime' : 'orange';
206:       ctx.fill();
207:       ctx.restore();
208:     });
209:     // HUD
210:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
211:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
212:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, ship.fuel.toFixed(0))}`, 10, 20);
213:   }
214: 
215: 
216: 
217:   function gameOver() {
218:     running = false;
219:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
220:     ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
221:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
222:   }
223: 
224:   // Start loop
225:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226: })();

(End of file - total 226 lines)
</content>
